_about: 50 student questions asked in the Physical Science chat (BSE Odisha, Class 9), to measure the tutor agent end to end: does it route each question right (answer here / send to the right subject / care / decline), does its answer come from the right chapter of her book, what the reviewer did, and how good the answer is (graded by a different model family). Run: apps/server/eval/agent_eval.ts. 'expect': answer = answered here from one of 'chapters'; redirect = sent to the 'subject' chat; care = the safety reply; decline = kindly says it only helps with studies (or gives no answer).
